title: For L¹-a.e. t, θ is H^m-integrable on M ∩ f⁻¹{t} ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, M ⊆ U, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ such that θ is H^{m+1}-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U, L ≥ 0, and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be arbitrary functions (no measurability assumed) with |G(x)| ≤ L for all x. Write Hᵏ := μHE[k] (Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P) and L¹ for Lebesgue measure on ℝ. Assume the co-area identity for (M, f, G): for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dH^m is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dH^m dt = ∫_M |G| g dH^{m+1}; and the null-transfer property for (M, f): every predicate that holds for H^{m+1}-a.e. x ∈ M holds, for L¹-a.e. t, for H^m-a.e. x ∈ M ∩ f⁻¹{t}. Then for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, θ is H^m-integrable on M ∩ f⁻¹{t} ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖G x‖ₑ * g x ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ p : Eucl P → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), p x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), p x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ K) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
